Definition: {a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion}
BiblicalUsage: gôwr means a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion. In Jeremiah 51:38, the text says "They shall roar together like lions."
TheologicalSignificance: In gôwr I find no hidden theology; it simply means a cub, especially of the lion.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
